dog.description_text: Meet Zella! Zella is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FZella%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQrmbalu%5FhmASYspGFxRvYaCEgUCHhWMRnz4WPttf2SMTnbEKQ Zella is a 3-1/2 year old female Orange Tabby. She has been spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. She is a lap cat! Her foster says she is a quiet girl and very intelligent who is curious, loves exploring, and enjoys following people around. "Zella looks really elegant, has a curious personality, and has really cute little meow! She's become very affectionate and loves cuddling with me! She's also quite responsive to people and loves to meow. She enjoys watching the world outside the window and taking naps. She loves cuddling with familiar people and will stare at you or meow to ask for more pets!" She appreciates a supportive environment as she settles in and gets comfortable in new surroundings. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
